content:
maya: Quick async check — console observability roadmap before sprint planning. Can folks drop a 1-line status? cc @sam @leo
sam: Dashboards mostly done. One PR open for the errors summary panel, should merge Wed. :thumbsup:
leo: Tracing hooks: added spans for router + cache. Missing payment path and webhook worker. @diane can you confirm ownership for payment path?
diane: I can take payment path tracing, ETA EOD Thu. Need the span naming convention first. @sam any docs?
sam: Using service.operation.format — e.g. `console.payment.process`. Small example to follow:
```json
{"span": "console.payment.process", "tags": {"user_id": "...", "route": "/v1/pay"}}
```
jen: Retention question — do we keep traces 30d or 7d for non-prod? Proposal in doc was 14d with sampling.
maya: Quick decision to unblock: prod traces 30d, non-prod traces 7d, and sample debug-level traces at 20% to save cost. If infra needs a different config, file INFRA ticket.
deploy-bot: Issue created: INFRA-452 retention policy for traces (assignee: jen)
jen: Ill pick INFRA-452, will run cost delta spike tomorrow and attach numbers here.
sam: Heads-up: dashboards will show a yellow "coverage" banner when trace coverage < 40% for a route. Owners should confirm which routes are critical for alerts.
maya: Owner assignments for next milestone: dashboards -> sam, traces -> diane + leo, errors -> jen. If anyone can't take this, speak now.
diane: OK from my side
leo: OK
jen: OK
maya: Thanks all. I'll update the roadmap doc and add the milestone + PR links. Ping here when PRs are ready or if blockers show up.
